The '''East Pedestrian Bridge''' was a bridge in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], that bordered [[Lake Varum]]. One of the legs of the [[Keren Street Race]] circuit led across the bridge.<ref name="SWG:KSR" />
